BiblicalUsage: Adummim was a pass on the road from Jericho up to Jerusalem — the ascent of Adummim, on the border between Judah and Benjamin. It appears twice, both times in lists marking the boundaries of the tribes; the place itself is covered in the Biblical Places collection.
TheologicalSignificance: A mountain pass in a boundary list carries no teaching, and I won't invent one. Its place is on the map: the steep road between two cities, marking where one tribe's land ended and another's began.
